groups.title: Accent colour
groups.description: Primary buttons, links, toggles, progress bars and focus rings. Text in the accent colour is darkened in light mode and lightened in dark mode when it needs to be, so it stays readable.

fields.label: Light mode
fields.css: html:not(.dark) { --color-accent: {{accent_light}}; --color-accent-text: oklch(from {{accent_light}} min(l, 0.5) c h); --color-on-accent: {{accent_light.on}}; --color-accent-soft: color-mix(in srgb, {{accent_light}} 9%, transparent); }

fields.label: Dark mode
fields.css: html.dark, .dark { --color-accent: {{accent_dark}}; --color-accent-text: oklch(from {{accent_dark}} max(l, 0.75) c h); --color-on-accent: {{accent_dark.on}}; --color-accent-soft: color-mix(in srgb, {{accent_dark}} 10%, transparent); }

groups.title: Sidebar in light mode
groups.description: Navy by default. With a light background the sidebar shows the logo for light backgrounds.

fields.label: Background
Text
fields.css: :where(html:not(.dark)) :is(.op-sidebar, .op-panel-sidebar) { --color-body: {{sidebar_light_text}}; --color-heading: color-mix(in oklab, {{sidebar_light_text}} 55%, {{sidebar_light_bg.on}}); --color-muted: color-mix(in oklab, {{sidebar_light_text}} 72%, {{sidebar_light_bg}}); --color-faint: color-mix(in oklab, {{sidebar_light_text}} 45%, {{sidebar_light_bg}}); --color-panel: color-mix(in oklab, {{sidebar_light_text}} 9%, {{sidebar_light_bg}}); --color-raised: color-mix(in oklab, {{sidebar_light_text}} 20%, {{sidebar_light_bg}}); }

groups.title: Sidebar in dark mode
groups.description: Shares the page background by default.

fields.label: Background
Text
fields.css: :where(html.dark) :is(.op-sidebar, .op-panel-sidebar) { --color-body: {{sidebar_dark_text}}; --color-heading: color-mix(in oklab, {{sidebar_dark_text}} 55%, {{sidebar_dark_bg.on}}); --color-muted: color-mix(in oklab, {{sidebar_dark_text}} 72%, {{sidebar_dark_bg}}); --color-faint: color-mix(in oklab, {{sidebar_dark_text}} 45%, {{sidebar_dark_bg}}); --color-panel: color-mix(in oklab, {{sidebar_dark_text}} 9%, {{sidebar_dark_bg}}); --color-raised: color-mix(in oklab, {{sidebar_dark_text}} 20%, {{sidebar_dark_bg}}); }
